scientific_scope: conditional theory; empirical classification not run

claims.title: Two physical axes, not three exclusive classes
assumptions: A declared homogeneous foliation with future normal N
A named material flow U
Observer O at one event; all physical four-velocities square to -c^2
claims.statement: Matter tilt is eta_UN=arcosh(-U.N/c^2); additional observer motion is eta_OU. U=N or U!=N and O=U or O!=U give four allowed combinations. O/U, O/N and O/R must retain distinct reference tags.
limits: A radiation zero-flux frame is not necessarily fully isotropic
A local or one-orbit result does not classify a whole cosmic history

claims.title: Exact zero-distance redshift intercept identifies matter/observer velocity
assumptions: Smooth common source U extends to observation event
Distances and directions admit a physically identified d_A->0 limit
Source redshifts use the same material spectral standard
Full angular intercept is known
claims.statement: For K=-o+n, Z(n)=lim(1+z)=K.u=zeta0+zeta.n, zeta0^2-|zeta|^2=1, zeta0>=1. The material velocity in the observer rest space is beta_U/O=zeta/zeta0. No geodesicity or expansion gap is needed.
limits: Finite catalogues do not supply this limit automatically
Cosmological smoothing across the local virial region needs an explicit extrapolation bound
Does not recover N or physical Bianchi tilt

claims.title: Hubble null-sky lift and geodesic matter eigenframe
assumptions: Geodesic physical source U at event
H_O(n)=c dz/dd_A at fixed n and zero distance is identified, with free redshift intercept
H_O=h0+h1.n+q:nn, q STF in O rest frame
The mixed symmetric representative has a unique future timelike eigenline
claims.statement: Construct covariant S00=h0,S0i=-h1_i/2,Sij=qij. The full null-sky kernel is span(g). If S^a_b u^b=s_t u^a, then B_ab=nabla_(a U_b)=S_ab-s_t g_ab and u=U/c. Nonzero spatial eigenvalues of B suffice for uniqueness. Vorticity does not enter this symmetric contraction.
limits: Slope only: diag(0,0,b2,b3) has a continuum of timelike kernels
This counterexample is an instantaneous kinematic jet, not a full Einstein family
An identified intercept can remove that degeneracy
Unrestricted source acceleration invalidates B.u=0
Cannot derive U vorticity from H alone
No finite-error eigenline coverage certificate yet

claims.title: Curvature-clock invariant identifies matter tilt
assumptions: Spacelike spatial homogeneity on open region
Metric scalar I invariant under isometries with nonzero timelike gradient
A physical U is specified
claims.statement: grad I fixes the orbit normal up to future sign. Xi=h_U^{ab} I_,a I_,b/[-(grad I)^2]=gamma_UN^2-1. Xi=0 iff U=N, Xi>0 iff tilt at the event. If U inherits the symmetry the statement extends across that connected orbit. Under single perfect fluid Einstein gravity with eps+p!=0 Ricci selects U; if I has metric differential order <=2, metric 3-jet suffices.
limits: Not an observational metric-jet reconstruction theorem
Constant or null/zero invariant gradients disable this route
Multicomponent stress selects a total energy frame, not every component
Invariant gradients must be collinear and any nonzero one timelike under stated homogeneity
Ricci and its derivative suffice only for a Ricci-built clock; a general algebraic curvature scalar can require Riemann and its derivative.

claims.title: Codazzi flux-to-tilt inversion and structural exclusions
assumptions: Einstein equation, kappa=8 pi G/c^4
K=-h h nabla n, n=N/c
Single perfect fluid plus optional Lambda
For quantitative interval branch: w=eps+p>0
claims.statement: J=-h T n=(D_b K^b_a-D_a K)/kappa; E_N+p=w gamma^2; beta=J/(E_N+p). In a homogeneous invariant frame C and K determine J algebraically. For C=0, J=0 forces non-tilt when w!=0. Let r=|J|/w: beta=2r/(1+sqrt(1+4r^2)); simultaneous intervals j in [j-,j+], w in [w-,w+] with j_minus>=0 and w_minus>0 yield [f(j-/w+),f(j+/w-)].
limits: Counterflow mixtures can have J_total=0 and tilted components
Imperfect matter invalidates perfect-fluid inversion
C,K are geometric inputs, not already inferred from current data
Only conforming homogeneous frame brackets may be used

claims.title: Endpoint-invariant distance and redshift contrasts
assumptions: Compare same physical source/ray and observer event with aberration reindexing
For luminosity equality: transparent metric propagation and reciprocity
claims.statement: With D=E_new/E_old, 1+z'=(1+z)/D, d_A'=D d_A, d_L'=d_L/D. Thus R=(1+z)d_A=d_L/(1+z) is invariant. Same-generator (1+z1)/(1+z2) cancels the observer factor. At angular separation delta and |beta|<=bmax<1 the residual log-factor magnitude is at most 2 bmax sin(delta/2)/(1-bmax).
limits: R is not d_A=d_L/(1+z)^2 used for Hubble derivative
Source velocities and normal geometry remain
Redshift-defined bins cannot create independent source-depth contrasts
A remapped scalar field is not pixel-by-pixel invariant without aberration

claims.title: Exact isotropic-blackbody endpoint criterion
assumptions: Positive absolute blackbody thermodynamic temperature sky
All observed directions refer to a single event
Null is precisely the scalar blackbody temperature/intensity sky obtained by one Lorentz boost of an isotropic temperature sky
claims.statement: There is a boost to an isotropic scalar blackbody temperature T0 iff 1/T_O(n)=a+b.n with a>|b|. In aligned axes beta_O/R=-b/a and T0=1/sqrt(a^2-|b|^2).
limits: Real intrinsic CMB anisotropies violate this strict null and require a stochastic intrinsic-sky family
Monopole-subtracted or component-separated fluctuation maps are not the required absolute sky
Rejecting this null does not reject non-tilted anisotropic Bianchi
Not a full experimental pipeline
The criterion alone does not certify isotropy of arbitrary polarization or of the full radiation field.

claims.title: Unrestricted intrinsic-sky inverse-boost degeneracy
assumptions: Intrinsic sky or probability-law family is closed under inverse Lorentz transformations
Only observer-endpoint radiation data are considered
claims.statement: For each candidate beta, f_beta=B_beta^{-1}f_obs is admissible, so endpoint data alone cannot identify beta. With a pushforward law and unchanged noise/observation operator the construction extends to the entire data law. Multiple frequencies or invertible MES rescaling alone cannot remove it.
limits: This is not a no-go for constrained intrinsic covariance families or independent matter/geometric data
Global physical admissibility must be checked rather than assumed from an algebraic inverse

claims.title: Velocity values do not determine kinematics
assumptions: A smooth velocity field is being inferred, not only a detector endpoint vector
claims.statement: Derivatives of U=gamma(N+c beta) depend on derivatives of beta and N. Equal beta at one point can coexist with different theta,sigma,omega,A. In Minkowski with c=1, U=(cosh r(t),sinh r(t),0,0) has theta=r' sinh r, A^2=(r')^2 cosh^2 r, sigma_ab sigma^ab=2 theta^2/3 and omega=0. Fixed r does not determine r'. Nonzero matter vorticity rules out equality with a hypersurface-normal field throughout a neighbourhood. It does not alone rule out equality of their values at a point. Explicit spatial symmetry inheritance permits the stronger same-orbit exclusion.
limits: Minkowski velocity example is test congruence kinematics, not a self-gravitating single perfect-fluid Einstein solution
Zero vorticity and zero acceleration do not prove non-tilt
Nonzero acceleration excludes equality with a geodesic normal field on a neighbourhood, not instantaneous U(p)=N(p); a homogeneous velocity can cross N at one time with nonzero acceleration.

claims.title: Joint identified-set classification with preserved normalization
assumptions: A sound joint 1-alpha confidence set C_alpha over a declared physical state/nuisance domain
Type, normal, material component and observer reference are explicit
Any outer prediction set contains all physical predictions for its tested class
claims.statement: Map C_alpha jointly to (Bianchi action label, eta_UN, eta_OU, tensors). The mapped set covers the true label with at least 1-alpha; empty intersection of sound outer predictions and a calibrated observation region excludes only that class. A positive lower eta_UN excludes non-tilt conditionally; an upper bound below preregistered epsilon gives practical equivalence, not exact zero.
limits: Constructing/calibrating C_alpha is not performed here
Do not compare separately fitted extrema that are not from a common joint set
State-dependent MES denominators remain inside the joint model; probabilities are not percentages of a bound
Tensor morphology, mask, frame, depth, covariance and x/Q/Pi/F/G_F version semantics remain explicit
